lines.text: Something was waiting in the corn. Oakhaven. Day twenty-one. The harvest won. Twelve of us went out to Hollow Creek. Mateen and Victoria on the corn and wheat. Guards working the rows. Two sharpshooters on the barn roof. And nobody worked alone. It was quiet, until Spenz climbed down from the roof. Something came out of the rows right under him. No legs. Dragging itself through the dirt. It missed his ankle by inches. A few rows over, another one caught Opeta Teo by the boot, and started pulling him into the corn. He kicked free before anyone else even saw it. Crawlers. You don't see them until you're on top of them. Twelve went out. Twelve came home, with the whole harvest. And now, it's here. Tonight, the horde reaches the fence. Last time, more than four hundred of them came, and we held. Nobody knows how many are coming this time. Forty-three of us. A hundred and twenty-seven rounds. A fence at full strength. Everyone who can hold a weapon is on the wall tonight. Where do we go tomorrow? The arcade, never searched. The show barn, nobody knows what's inside. Or the surplus store, to help Ryan get back the gear he had to leave behind. Comment your name and your job, to move in.
